reason: The paper's abstract and introduction describe PipeDream as pipeline parallelism for faster DNN training; its forward/backward pipeline and experiments measure training throughput and time-to-accuracy. It does not target LLM inference or inference-serving efficiency. The full primary paper was available from the author-hosted Berkeley PDF after the DOI resolver itself returned an internal error.
title: PipeDream: generalized pipeline parallelism for DNN training
